description: This file defines classes and functions related to MKL-DNN IR nodes and utilities for convolution, linear, and RNN operations, including creation, code generation, and layout handling within the PyTorch _inductor backend.

classes.name: ConvolutionUnary
classes.description: ExternKernelAlloc subclass for CPU MKL-DNN convolution pointwise unary operations.

classes.name: ConvolutionBinary
classes.description: ExternKernelAlloc subclass for CPU MKL-DNN convolution pointwise binary operations.

classes.name: ConvolutionBinaryInplace
classes.description: Inplace variant of ConvolutionBinary, mutates the second input tensor.

classes.name: ConvolutionTransposeUnary
classes.description: ExternKernelAlloc subclass for transposed convolution pointwise unary operations.

classes.name: QConvPointWisePT2E
classes.description: Quantized convolution pointwise operation with PT2E backend.

classes.name: QConvPointWiseBinaryPT2E
classes.description: Quantized binary convolution pointwise operation with PT2E backend.

classes.name: MKLPackedLinear
classes.description: ExternKernelAlloc subclass for MKL-DNN packed linear layer.

classes.name: LinearUnary
classes.description: ExternKernelAlloc subclass for linear unary operations.

classes.name: LinearBinary
classes.description: ExternKernelAlloc subclass for linear binary operations.

classes.name: QLinearPointwisePT2E
classes.description: Quantized linear pointwise operation with PT2E backend.

classes.name: QLinearPointwiseBinaryPT2E
classes.description: Quantized binary linear pointwise operation with PT2E backend.

classes.name: MkldnnRnnLayer
classes.description: ExternKernelAlloc subclass for MKL-DNN RNN layer.

classes.name: WeightInt4PackMatmul
classes.description: ExternKernelAlloc subclass for weight packing in int4 quantized matmul.

methods.name: _prepare_convolution_fusion_create
methods.description: Prepares inputs, layout, and args for convolution fusion creation.

methods.name: _prepare_linear_fusion_create
methods.description: Prepares inputs, layout, and args for linear fusion creation.

methods.name: _create_output_node
methods.description: Creates a MultiOutput IR node from a packed kernel.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Class method to instantiate and initialize kernel objects for various operations.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Generates code for the kernel, including necessary headers.
